funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage, author or editor of a proposed publication with a confirmed publisher and publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles related to British art, visual culture and architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (tiered funding); postdoctoral level for higher tier; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding to support research travel and time, covering travel, accommodation, subsistence and research costs for projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled to start or already undertaking a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture at a UK institution.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount funding to help students begin or continue their postgraduate studies in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support research trips to study eighteenth‑ and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a master’s degree place at a UK institution, starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a master’s degree to bring new perspectives to British art research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a doctorate at a UK university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (home fee vs. international fee distinction).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research in British art, covering tuition and living costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 per year (up to £70,000 for two years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral level researchers or those with equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised experts.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome for advanced research on British‑Italian cultural exchange, including board, accommodation and honorarium.
